Method of Attack: Laundering money stolen from hacked Bitcoin trading platforms
Allowing ransomware operators to convert Bitcoin into fiat currency and cash-out illegal activities
Impacted Systems: Cryptocurrency exchanges including Mt. Gox, Bitcoinica, Bitfloor
Ransomware operations such as Locky, Cerber, NotPetya, WannaCry, Spora, CryptoWall
Attack Vector: Operation of an unlicensed money exchange platform
Use as a Bitcoin wallet for laundering stolen funds
Conversion of ransomware payments to fiat currency
Indicators of Compromise: DOJ indictment on 21 charges related to money laundering
Arrest of Alexander Vinnik, owner of BTC-e
Seizure of electronic equipment by Greek police
Research presented at Black Hat USA 2017 showing 95% of ransom payments cashed out through BTC-e
